outputs.explanation: The top bar chart in panel A shows mean±s.d. cell death percentages across three independent experiments, but only bars with error bars are shown—no individual data points from the replicate experiments are overlaid.
The bar chart in panel B shows averaged cell death percentages (with error bars) but does not overlay the individual data points behind the means.
The bar chart shows mean±s.d. cell death values from three experiments at each time point, but individual replicate values are not shown as overlaid points.
The top bar chart in panel D shows average cell death percentages with error bars but no individual data points are displayed. (The western blot portion of this panel is not a quantitative plot.)
